newsitem.title: ESTONIA: KALEV APRIL PROFIT 1.9 MLN KROONS.
newsitem.headline: KALEV APRIL PROFIT 1.9 MLN KROONS.

text.p: Kalev confectionary maker said on Tuesday that its April profit was 1.9 million kroons compared to March's five million kroons.
The sweets producer said in a statement that its balance volume grew by 7.2 percent or 12.5 million kroons to 186.1 million kroons during the same period.
The company's net turnover in April was 33.3 million kroons and its net profit was 6.8 million kroons.

The compnay also said that it has increased its reserves of raw materials by 7.7 million kroons to 50.7 million kroons, because of the favourable rates for raw materials on the world market at present.
The company's net profit was 6.7 million kroons and total turnover was 33.3 million kroons.
